name: Maverick Hunter - Black Zero
desc:
2 Level 4 Machine monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can add 1 "Maverick Boost" Quick-Play Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. If this card Xyz Summoned using at least 1 "Zero" monster as material, it gains these effects:
● Gain 1000 ATK
● Neither player can activate card or effect in response to it's effect.
(Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, this card is unaffected by your opponent's card effect until the end of the next turn.
